labels.rationale: The requested text color is already available through Rich styles and console markup.

items.body:
Use Rich's `style` parameter to set a foreground color, for example `console.print("Hello", style="orange1")`. Console markup works too: `[orange1]Hello[/]`. See [Styles](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/style.rst) and [Console Markup](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/markup.rst). For usage questions, please ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
